<!-- One design, component or board per pull request. -->

**Design or entry:** `designs/<name>/` or `library/<components|boards>/<id>/`

**Built it?** <!-- yes / not yet / partly -- and on what board -->

- [ ] It is mine to license: a design under CC-BY-4.0, a component or board under MIT.
- [ ] It contains no literal credentials (Wi-Fi, API, OTA or LoRaWAN keys).
- [ ] Any photos are of the build, taken by me, with no people in them.
- [ ] If it builds on another design, `derived_from` or the README credits it.
- [ ] A component or board's `source` is the datasheet or product page I wrote it from.
